Purpose – quick-reference for the founder. No screen‑recording required.

You’re on the Growing plan (£22 mo) so per‑service start‑time overrides are available – they’re just hidden deep in the UI (see §4).

3. Availability Rules

3·1 — Content Creation – Weekday/Off‑Peak

Mon–Fri 10:00–23:00 (regular hours)

Nov 1 → Apr 30 Sat & Sun 10:00–23:00 (date‑range override)

3·2 — Content Creation – Peak Weekend (10‑12)

May 1 → Oct 31 Sat & Sun 10:00–12:00 (date‑range override)

3·3 — Workshop Hire – Hourly (Weekdays)

Mon–Fri 10:00–17:00

3·4 — Workshop Hire – Full‑Day (Weekends)

Sat & Sun 10:00–22:00

3·5 — Event – Half‑Day

Day slot inherits Daytime 10‑17

Evening slot inherits Evening 17‑23

3·6 — Event – Full‑Day / Late Finish

Full Day = 10‑22

Late Finish = 10‑23

3·7 — Studio Viewing

Tue 14:00–16:00 (20‑min cadence)

4. Start‑Time Cadence (per‑service override)

UI path: Availability › Calendars › [calendar] › Set different hours… › Calendar scheduling limits › scroll to bottom › Start times for this appointment type.

Service

Outcome

Content Creation – Peak Weekend

60 min

Shows 10 AM & 11 AM

Workshop Hire – Hourly

60 min

Adds 4 PM start (ends 5:20 PM)

Studio Viewing

20 min

2 :00 · 2 :20 · 2 :40 · 3 :00 · 3 :20

If you skip this step, Acuity defaults to 80‑minute jumps (10:00 · 11:20 · 12:40 …).

5. Season Logic – No Manual Toggles

Date‑range overrides (see §3·1 & 3·2) ensure the correct windows appear; outside the range Acuity shows Closed. Nothing to switch on/off.

6. Why Workshop Hourly Ends 5:20 PM

60‑min service + 20‑min pad → last start 16:004:00‑5:00 service + 5:00‑5:20 pad = 17:20 hard cut‑off.

7. Late‑Finish Upsell (£940)

Separate calendar prevents normal hires from over‑running.

Duration 13 h covers set‑up + pack‑down.

Pricing = £840 base + £100 late premium.

8. Quick “How‑To” Cheats (for founder)

Task

Path

Change a price

Appointment Types › Edit › Price

Create / edit a calendar

Availability › Add New Calendar or Calendar settings

Block out a holiday

Change start‑time cadence

See §4 steps

Fix yellow banner

Extend calendar hours or reduce padding so (duration + pad) ≤ calendar window

Stop double‑booking

Calendar scheduling limits › Appointments per time slot = 1

9. Troubleshooting Flowchart

Slot missing?‑ Check calendar hours contain service + pad.‑ Check per‑type override not Closed.

Can’t see hourly option?‑ You’re already on “Growing”—just use §4 steps.

Client can’t pick weekend shoot in Feb?‑ That’s correct – peak‑weekend window only runs May‑Oct.

10. Website Update Brief – hand to junior dev

Objective (big boulder): Home page must expose all eight hire options and deep‑link straight into Acuity. No more two‑package grid, no instant‑quote detour, no online payment.
